units: SI. Accepted calls are 60 Hz; solverSubsteps are 240 Hz internal steps.
scope: Hypothetical compiler-admitted development comparisons. These receipts do not claim purchases, installed inventory, rewards or a playable test facility.

rules.startingPose: Identical stock-equilibrium origin, yaw 0, zero pitch/roll for each model; test-specific initial velocity.

straight.crossing: First 100 km/h crossing linearly interpolated between consecutive accepted horizontal speeds; null if not reached within 720 calls.

braking.policy: Full brake from declared exact initial horizontal speed to first accepted speed <=0.1 m/s. Report accepted path length and stop tick; no terminal pose assignment.

bump.geometry: h(z)=0.04*sin(pi*(-z-8)/4)^2 for -12<z<-8; h=0 elsewhere. Normal is normalized [0,1,-dh/dz].

rules.comparison: Straight/corner/steering/bump runs use identical complete timed command streams and explicit initial poses/velocities. Braking uses an identical deterministic stop policy with potentially different accepted lengths. Heading change sums shortest consecutive accepted heading differences to unwrap the reported angle.

initialPose.velocity: Per test velocity is declared in rules; this common pose is taken from the actual accepted spawn.

summaryPolicy: Complete source/rules/identity, measured metrics/diagnostics and terminal states are retained. Terminal rows use the declared lossless column order. An identicalTo reference means the complete measured run, including all omitted samples, hashes identically to the named stock run. Timed samples are reduced to straight tick120 speed/RPM and steering tick3 response. Endurance recipes reconstruct from model, canonicalBuild and source and are checked against recipe digests. Every full run/result and complete default-output bytes have SHA-256 identities.
